json.reason: The respondent pasted an identical sentence, 'Everything was fine and easy to use,' into four distinct open-ended questions that each called for a different substantive answer. This clearly indicates disengagement and a lack of sincere effort to answer the survey properly.
json.panel_text: On four different questions that asked you for details about software decisions or recommendations, you wrote exactly the same reply: “Everything was fine and easy to use.” Repeating the same sentence on questions that ask for different explanations is not acceptable and shows you did not answer sincerely.
